v2.adjudication_note: Different base and stacked factors: the coordinator scored a composite (nudge level, the post hoc lull reversal, human content pull, no daily gauge) at primary base and credited H04/H35 as cross-hypothesis replication and the bystander placebo separately; the blind rater used secondary base and partial factors. Ruling: secondary base (the 1b design was redesigned after round 1), score only the nudge level with bystanders, drop the lull split (post hoc, reversed by the data fix) and the daily-gauge clause (permutation power 0.7 < 0.8); H04's corrected number is the same period and data, not replication. Fragile stays true (G38 changed significance).
